name: Erin Blanchfield
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: The No. 4 flyweight (14-2, 8-1 UFC), a 27-year-old BJJ black belt from Renzo Gracie who mixes high-volume boxing with chain wrestling and back takes. Returns from an undisclosed injury that pulled her out of the August date with Jasudavicius; she has not fought since submitting Tracy Cortez in November 2025. Never finished; both losses are decisions.

how_they_fight.Striking: Busy, straight-punching boxer (about 5.2 significant strikes a minute) who uses volume to set up entries more than to hurt people: no knockdowns in her UFC fights in our data. Lost the striking early against Rose Namajunas and Tracy Cortez, and Manon Fiorot out-landed her 172-130 at range over five rounds.
how_they_fight.Grappling: The weapon: four UFC submission wins (McCann R1; J.J. Aldrich, Jessica Andrade and Tracy Cortez all R2). Against Cortez she got the takedown and immediately took the back for a rear-naked choke at 4:44 of R2. Took Miranda Maverick down 7 of 8 times for 12 minutes of control. Not unstoppable as a wrestler: 0-for-14 on takedowns against Taila Santos and 0-for-3 against Fiorot (per our data).
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped in 16 pro fights. Good takedown defense (about 83%) and very hard to hold down. Can be out-struck at range by longer, sharper kickboxers.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Slow starter, strong finisher. Dropped rounds 1-2 to Namajunas before taking rounds 3-5 (48-47 x3), and lost R1 to Cortez on all cards without a takedown attempt before finishing her in R2. Her finishes cluster in round 2 (3 of 4 UFC subs). Has gone five rounds twice (beat Namajunas, lost to Fiorot) and her pace holds up.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Adjusts well between rounds: when the striking isn't working she switches to wrestling and grinds. Patient on top; hunts the back rather than wild submissions.

patterns: Gives away round 1 on the feet, then takes over with takedowns from round 2
Takedown -> immediate back take -> rear-naked choke
UFC submissions in R1 (1) and R2 (3); otherwise wins clear decisions
Never finished: both career losses are decisions (Cortez 2019 split, Fiorot 2024)
Outworks opponents late; won the championship rounds against Namajunas
concerns: Coming back from an injury that forced her out of UFC 330; nearly a year out of the cage
Takedowns don't land against strong, bigger wrestlers (Santos) or rangy strikers (Fiorot)
Early-round striking deficits leave her behind on the cards
Fighting a home favourite in Canada
keys_to_beat: Win round 1 clearly on the feet and keep it at range
Defend the first takedown and get up before she reaches the back
Use size and strength in the clinch (as Santos did) to deny her wrestling
Out-land her at distance as Fiorot did; don't grapple on her terms

news.text: Withdrew from the August 15 UFC 330 bout with Jasudavicius with an undisclosed injury; the fight was moved to UFC Edmonton.
Betting favourite at -300 (Jasudavicius +240), per MMA Junkie.
Per UFC.com, Jasudavicius handed Blanchfield's training partner and close friend Fatima Kline her first loss, adding a personal edge.
